en.title: Group Students into Classes by Skill Level
en.description:
Given each student's skill value, assign all students to some number of non-empty classes. Within each class, the difference between the highest and lowest skill values must not exceed maxSpread. Find the minimum number of classes; students in the same class can be chosen freely and need not be contiguous in the original array.

The standard input format, examples and test data were written by CSWork.
en.input: The first line contains n maxSpread (1≤n≤100000, 0≤maxSpread≤10⁹), and the second line contains n skill values (1..10⁹).
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer required by the problem.
en.explanation: Example 1 can be split into two classes, [1,4] and [7,8], with spans 3 and 1.
hints: Sort the skill values. Each time, take the lowest unassigned value as the start of a new class, and put every following student whose value is at most start+maxSpread into that class.
